fulfilled_source_needs: ETCSL is identified from Oxford's own documentation as a completed 1997–2006 project and a collaborative 1998–2006 digital scholarly corpus Work

its nearly four hundred reconstructed Sumerian literary compositions, transliterations, English prose translations, bibliography, and search are preserved as discoverable historical capabilities rather than silently imported content
the prescribed citation and seven named contributors are modeled without flattening director, editor, developer, and associate roles into ancient authorship
ETCSL's own warning that reconstructed texts and translations can age establishes a currentness control for every later composition-level use
ORACC and ePSD2 provide a current transformation and lemmatization route while remaining distinct releases whose character, lemma, and translation coverage must be compared
CDLI supplies a stable publication route and future physical-witness context without making a publication record equal to a tablet or critical edition
established corpus, textual-criticism, and Linked Open Data scholarship separates navigation and derived graph utility from manuscript authority
a fresh SumTablets preprint is retained only as a future OCR and transliteration challenger whose reported aggregate score does not establish literary-text accuracy
an A/B/C laboratory design is prepared for ETCSL-only, current successor comparison, and manuscript-returnable critical reconstruction
remaining_controls: ETCSL is not a continuously maintained critical edition and must be checked against current composition-specific scholarship before supporting a reading
a project Work is not the ancient corpus, an individual composition, a manuscript, a transliteration Expression, a translation, an Edition, or an Item
the exact OTA revised-edition files, version identity, checksums, licence, and redistribution terms remain unresolved and no payload is admitted
public web access and OTA public availability do not by themselves grant redistribution, publication, or model-training rights
ETCSL composite lines must not erase variant manuscripts, lacunae, restorations, recopying history, or uncertainty
ORACC and ePSD2 transformations are not presumed textually identical to ETCSL and their omitted translations and changed lemmata remain material
the DCSL project record is current, but its named endpoint and an inspectable release were not verified and it is not called ETCSL's active successor
SumTablets is a 2026 preprint and derived dataset, not a critical edition, rights authority for upstream data, or human-verified reading
the later A02 backlog label ETCSL project publications must reuse this Work and discovery route unless a distinct publication is planted as its own Work

no source body, ancient Work, Collection, membership, Expression, Edition, Item, artifact, composite, reading, translation, lemma, semantic object, graph relation, canon state, access request, external communication, or human task is admitted
